No sleep-led angle: poor sleep is listed as a pain in 9 scripts but never the hook; nothing about waking at 3 a.m., 'melatonin can't work while cortisol is high', or morning capsule timing. Only one time-of-day scene exists (a 2:47 AM hot flash).
No afternoon-crash or energy-timing angle beyond a line inside the pharmacist script and one 'no third coffee' testimonial; 'the 3pm crash' is open as a hook.
No puffy-face / 'moon face' angle: swelling is ankles and shoes (m2237566630334105); face puffiness, a core AVIA pain, is untouched.

No cited studies and no dose transparency: every 'study' is unnamed ('New Study Reveals', 'Harvard researchers', 'a 12-week study of 35 women'); no mg, no standardisation, no ingredient-level clinical reference. AVIA's 'seven clinically studied ingredients, clinically dosed' is the exact proof vocabulary this brand lacks.

No guarantee-led or price-led creative: 30-day money back appears once (3d); no dollar price, cost-per-day, bundle or subscription language in 150 scripts. Guarantee and per-day value framing are open.

No under-45 perimenopause lead that survived: 'body changes around 35' (49d) is the only one; perimenopause 45+ has 1 winner in 6 scripts. The 40-50 working woman with stress, not menopause, is under-served.
